scientific_integrity: Classical facet and hook-length ingredients are attributed. The independent mathematical audit was not performed; computational results are only corroborative.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats rooted-tree order polytopes in the standard coordinate Euclidean embedding only.
No third or higher interior extremal levels, arbitrary posets, or alternate embeddings are classified.
Historical priority remains provisional under alternative poset/convex-body formulations; the relevant generalized-snake-poset PDF was inspected.
Computational evidence is finite and is not an infinite proof.
title: The first two intrinsic-volume extremizers among rooted-tree order polytopes
